identity.name: UN News
identity.description: The official news service of the United Nations, publishing multilingual coverage of peace and security, humanitarian affairs, development, human rights and the UN system.

ownership.parentOrganization: UN Secretariat, Department of Global Communications
ownership.ownershipNotes: An intergovernmental communication channel rather than an independent commercial publisher. Editorial output is institutionally tied to the UN Secretariat and its member-state mandate.

editorialOrientation.evidence: UN News is the Secretariat's official communications channel and frames events within UN mandates, resolutions and member-state positions.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via secondary references (official about page blocked or unavailable); secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: Multilateral, consensus-oriented framing rather than partisan domestic politics; positions are negotiated among member states.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is framed through development, humanitarian and sustainable-development mandates rather than a market or partisan economic programme.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Coverage consistently centres UN mandates, General Assembly and Security Council processes, and humanitarian-law frameworks.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Official institutional publisher with named spokespeople, documents and correction channels; the main limitation is institutional framing, not fabrication.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No MBFC rating identified for UN News. Reliability assessed from the institutional publisher and official documentation.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Multilateral institutional voice. Frames conflicts and crises through UN mandates, humanitarian access, development targets and member-state diplomacy, often emphasising consensus and process over partisan confrontation.

selectionRationale: Provides an authoritative baseline for UN decisions, humanitarian appeals and multilateral diplomacy that commercial wires often cover only episodically.

feeds.feedTitle: UN News - Global perspective Human stories
feeds.validationNote: 30 items in validation sample; returns valid RSS.

research.researchNotes: About page returned HTTP 406 to the research client; identity and mandate verified through the UN DGC reference entry and feed metadata. Existing production mapping retained. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
